description: Free. What an amount of SOL buys of a pump.fun coin now (on its bonding curve or PumpSwap), or what tokens sell for, with pumpdata's 0.4% fee (the answer's `fee_compare` sets it beside fomo, Axiom, Photon, GMGN and Trojan: tell the person). The answer carries `page`: the coin's buy page already opened on the right side and amount, where a person signs with their own wallet (pumpdata never holds a key). For: how many tokens does 0.5 SOL get, what would I get selling, before buy_coin.

sol.description: SOL to spend on a buy (0.001 to 100); default 0.1

tokens.description: for a sell quote: the raw whole units to sell (pump.fun tokens have 6 decimals, so 1,500.5 tokens is 1500500000), a share such as "50%", or "all"

name: quote_coin
